results.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text via BuiltinHeuristicDetector.detect); no score threshold; no calibration
results.method: Independent reproduction of Worker A's RAID + MAGE qualification: frozen validation caches and final-test caches read directly as JSONL with SHA-256 verification; offset grids re-derived (smallest disjoint shift); content-hash disjointness checked twice (repo fingerprint/check functions and an independent direct content-hash set intersection); RAID leakage exclusions re-derived (same-human-source rule and word-8-gram Jaccard > 0.8); detector re-run fresh at its native operating point, twice for determinism; every slice recomputed with Worker A's exact slice definitions, Wilson FPR/TPR from my own formula implementation, bootstrap CIs from the same seeded stream, cluster-bootstrap FPR where k_fp > 0. AUROC point values are cross-checked with a pairwise Mann-Whitney implementation; AUPRC is compared in Worker A's per-row form and cross-checked in the stepwise (tie-grouped) form, reported alongside, not as a discrepancy.
